items.text: Thinking Machines released Inkling 2 Small as open source, reaching first among U.S. open models in Agent Arena.
items.text_zh: Thinking Machines 开源 Inkling 2 Small，在 Agent Arena 美国开源模型榜升至第一。
items.cat_take_en: Open weights plus top domestic-agent ranking make Inkling a credible challenger, though reproducibility depends on missing training details.
items.cat_take_zh: 开放权重叠加美国开源榜首让它具备挑战力，但训练细节不足仍限制复现与评估。

items.text: Liquid AI released LiquidCodec, a 74-million-parameter streaming audio codec designed for efficient real-time generation.
items.text_zh: Liquid AI 发布 7400 万参数的 LiquidCodec 流式音频编解码器，面向高效实时生成。
items.cat_take_en: A compact codec could lower latency for voice agents, but real-world quality and licensing remain the decisive adoption tests.
items.cat_take_zh: 紧凑编解码器有望降低语音智能体延迟，但真实音质与许可条款仍决定能否落地。

items.text: CopilotKit released OpenBot 1.0, an MIT-licensed, self-hostable AI coworker with built-in governance controls.
items.text_zh: CopilotKit 发布 OpenBot 1.0：采用 MIT 许可、支持自托管，并内置治理控制的 AI 同事。
items.cat_take_en: Self-hosting and governance target enterprise objections directly, but OpenBot must prove reliability beyond its permissive license.
items.cat_take_zh: 自托管与治理正面回应企业顾虑，但仅有宽松许可还不足以证明可靠性。

items.text: Microsoft made MAI-Transcribe-2 generally available in Foundry for production transcription workloads.
items.text_zh: 微软宣布 MAI-Transcribe-2 在 Foundry 正式可用于生产级转写工作负载。
items.cat_take_en: General availability turns Microsoft’s speech model into deployable infrastructure, but buyers still need independent accuracy checks across languages.
items.cat_take_zh: 正式商用让该模型成为可部署基础设施，但多语言准确率仍需买方独立验证。

items.text: Figma added native 3D transforms, letting users rotate layers across three axes and send the resulting designs directly to coding agents.
items.text_zh: Figma 加入原生 3D 变换，支持三轴旋转，并可将设计直接交给编码智能体。
items.cat_take_en: Mapping spatial design to CSS and agents compresses handoff time, while open-beta limits keep production workflows cautious.
items.cat_take_zh: 空间设计可直接映射 CSS 并交给智能体，缩短交接，但开放测试仍限制生产信心。

items.text: Krea introduced Krea Bots, creative agents that take on entire projects and adapt to a team’s preferences during collaboration.
items.text_zh: Krea 推出 Krea Bots，可承担完整创意项目，并在团队协作中适应用户偏好。
items.cat_take_en: Project-level creative agents could replace fragmented tool chains, but the beta’s $1,000 credit offer signals that product-market fit is unproven.
items.cat_take_zh: 项目级创意智能体可能替代零散工具链，但测试期赠送 1000 美元额度也说明市场匹配尚未验证。

items.text: Runway added text-to-3D and image-to-3D generation through Tripo H3.1, with models viewable from any angle in its workflow.
items.text_zh: Runway 接入 Tripo H3.1，支持文生 3D 和图生 3D，并可在工作流中自由查看模型角度。
items.cat_take_en: Embedding 3D generation beside video tools benefits creators, but credit costs and mesh cleanup remain practical bottlenecks.
items.cat_take_zh: 把 3D 生成放进视频工具会惠及创作者，但积分成本与网格清理仍是现实瓶颈。

items.text: ElevenLabs opened a Marketplace connecting enterprises with partner-built voice agents and applications for regulated industries.
items.text_zh: ElevenLabs 开放 Marketplace，连接企业与面向受监管行业的合作伙伴语音智能体和应用。
items.cat_take_en: A curated partner layer can accelerate enterprise deployment, while ElevenLabs gains ecosystem leverage without building every vertical itself.
items.cat_take_zh: 精选伙伴层能加速企业部署，也让 ElevenLabs 无需自建每个行业方案便扩大生态影响。

items.text: Gradio 6.32.0 now requires login for authenticated MCP servers and supports queued authenticated MCP calls.
items.text_zh: Gradio 6.32.0 为带认证应用的 MCP 服务器增加登录要求，并支持排队的认证 MCP 调用。
items.cat_take_en: Authentication closes a meaningful MCP deployment gap, though developers must now manage identity flows that prototypes previously ignored.
items.cat_take_zh: 认证机制补上 MCP 部署短板，但开发者也必须面对原型阶段常被忽略的身份管理。

items.text: HeyGen integrated Gemini Omni Flash 1.2 for text-to-video and image-to-video clips with generated audio and multi-turn editing.
items.text_zh: HeyGen 接入 Gemini Omni Flash 1.2，支持带生成音频和多轮编辑的文生视频、图生视频片段。
items.cat_take_en: Audio, video, and iterative editing in one avatar workflow lowers production friction, but short clips still constrain narrative complexity.
items.cat_take_zh: 音频、视频与多轮编辑合一能降低制作摩擦，但短片时长仍限制叙事复杂度。

items.text: Replit Agent can now purchase items for businesses using product context, budgets, and user approval.
items.text_zh: Replit Agent 现在可基于产品背景和预算，在用户批准后为企业购买商品。
items.cat_take_en: Agentic commerce moves from recommendation to execution, making approval design and transaction liability the central unresolved risks.
items.cat_take_zh: 智能体商业从推荐迈向执行，审批设计与交易责任成为尚未解决的核心风险。

items.text: Pinecone added Google’s Gemini Embedding 2 to integrated embedding, allowing plain-text fields to produce vectors directly.
items.text_zh: Pinecone 将 Google Gemini Embedding 2 加入集成嵌入，纯文本字段现在可直接生成向量。
items.cat_take_en: Direct model choice simplifies retrieval setup for teams, but dependence on a hosted embedding provider preserves portability concerns.
items.cat_take_zh: 直接选择模型简化了检索配置，但依赖托管嵌入服务仍会带来迁移与可携带性问题。

items.text: Hugging Face and IBM introduced LLMON, an LLM-native markup language now integrated into Granite 4.1 models.
items.text_zh: Hugging Face 与 IBM 推出 LLMON，一种已集成进 Granite 4.1 模型的 LLM 原生标记语言。
items.cat_take_en: A model-oriented markup layer could make structured prompting more portable, but adoption depends on tooling beyond IBM’s model family.
items.cat_take_zh: 面向模型的标记层可能提升结构化提示的可移植性，但普及取决于 IBM 之外的工具支持。

items.text: AWS announced a next-generation AgentCore runtime promising faster startup, more compute scaling, and higher efficiency for agent sessions.
items.text_zh: AWS 宣布新一代 AgentCore 运行时，主打更快启动、更高计算扩展能力和更高智能体会话效率。
items.cat_take_en: Runtime efficiency directly affects agent economics, but the headline gains need workload-specific validation before they justify migration.
items.cat_take_zh: 运行时效率会直接影响智能体成本，但迁移前仍需按工作负载验证这些宣传增益。

items.text: The FAA expanded AI-based advice for managing air-traffic congestion across the entire United States airspace.
items.text_zh: 美国 FAA 将基于 AI 的空域拥堵管理建议扩大至全美空域。
items.cat_take_en: Nationwide deployment gives AI a consequential operational role, but safety cases and human override remain more important than scale.
items.cat_take_zh: 全国部署让 AI 进入高后果运行环节，但安全论证与人工接管比覆盖规模更关键。

items.text: OpenAI described Amplitude’s Wave agent using product data and coding agents to ship improvements in one to two days.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 介绍 Amplitude 的 Wave 智能体如何结合产品数据与编码智能体，在一至两天内交付改进。
items.cat_take_en: The 160% lift in suggestion-card engagement shows measurable product impact, but the result is a single-company case study.
items.cat_take_zh: 建议卡互动提升 160% 证明产品影响可量化，但目前仍只是单一公司的案例证据。
